title: mid sickle
description:
Helps you break grass faster
MID for terraforming
body:
This mod adds a copper sickle into the game. You craft it with 1 stick, 1 copper ingot, 1 gold nugget, and 2 iron nuggets in a formation like this:
![Crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cb68dad347297084d94193e7a044ae21d3666132.png)

The advantage of using this is that it breaks all a grass/tall grass around it in a 5x5 square.
